subject.title: fix(codex): backoff startup connection-close retries and surface exhaustion (#83959) [AI-assisted]

question: Should this PR's bounded five-attempt backoff be accepted as the Codex startup-close fix, or should the branch be held for an explicit app-server readiness gate before merge?
rationale: Both paths address the same P1 startup failure, but the choice changes availability latency and diagnostic semantics rather than a purely mechanical code defect.

options.title: Accept Bounded Backoff
options.body: Merge after maintainer acknowledgement that the bounded, abortable retry window is sufficient and a readiness receipt can remain a follow-up if needed.

options.title: Require Readiness Gate
options.body: Ask the contributor or a repair worker to gate retry admission on replacement-server readiness before this PR can land.

options.title: Pause For Broader Startup Work
options.body: Defer this PR in favor of a broader shared-client/startup lifecycle change if maintainers want one canonical fix for the related cluster.

recommendation.title: Accept Bounded Backoff
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer acknowledgement that the bounded, abortable retry window is sufficient and a readiness receipt can remain a follow-up if needed.
